correctness.rationale: The robust-region inequalities are exactly equivalent to a scalar trace parameter in the interval from minus twice to plus twice the square root of the momentum. The two-step product has determinant equal to the square of the momentum and trace ranging from minus six to plus two times the momentum. The complete quadratic Jury criterion gives the sharp threshold, and endpoint alternation attains it.
